llm.summary: This skill is mostly a coherent writing-voice generator, but it automatically trusts local project files and unvalidated register names in ways that can read or apply unintended Markdown instructions.

dimensions.detail: Read, Bash, Write, and Agent use is broadly coherent for a voice-generation workflow, but automatic project override loading and unvalidated register path construction exceed a clearly bounded profile/register access model.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown-only, metadata lists related scribe plugin requirements, and no install script, dependency download, remote payload, hook, or tool replacement was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill applies `.voice/override.md` from the current project with precedence over the profile and constructs register file paths from raw register names without validation, creating prompt-injection and out-of-scope file-read risks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No system persistence or privilege escalation is present; the only persistence-like behavior is saving snapshots when learning mode is active, which is purpose-related but should be user-controlled.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to generate text from an extracted writing profile, and reading voice profiles, registers, craft rules, banned phrases, and optional review/learning snapshots fits that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the projects where you use it and understand that it may read local voice-profile files plus `.voice/override.md`. Avoid using it in untrusted repositories, and prefer profiles/registers with strict filename validation and an explicit review of any project override before generation.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad triggers such as `voice`, `generation`, and `writing` are real in the artifact and could invoke the skill outside explicit voice-profile generation requests.
[SQP-2] expected: Loading `$HOME/.claude/voice-profiles` is expected for this skill, but the artifact also reads optional project override content without a confirmation or validation boundary.
[P4] expected: Default source framing as rough notes is a disclosed generation technique, but users should know it may change how structured input is treated unless they explicitly request another framing.
[SQP-2] expected: Silent banned-phrase and punctuation auto-fixes are aligned with the stated output-quality goal, but they can alter wording without showing a diff.
[T01] unexpected: The project override file is treated as higher-priority voice configuration even though repository files may be untrusted and free-form.
[T09] unexpected: The register-selection module interpolates `REGISTER_NAME` into a Markdown file path without allowlisting or containment checks, so traversal outside the register directory is plausible.
